titulo: Me making small talk about the weather
caption:
Me making small talk about the weather

Me making small talk about the weather.

It is never about the weather. It is a tiny way of saying I am here and I am friendly. Awkward still counts.

Send it to the friend who always opens with the weather.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A staircase room. Two small block figures with white eyes, an ink-black one on the left and a navy one on the right, face each other. The black one says nice weather in a speech bubble and the navy one answers yeah. The black one adds might rain and the navy one answers mhm. Then both look away in silence and, at the end, narrow their eyes at the camera. The text stays: me making small talk about the weather.
